a2-03-01.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Pier
a2-03-01.scenario: The group is at the pier in Tam Cốc. Meg asks what you have done so far. You have bought the tickets and you have seen the caves.
a2-03-01.prompt: Tell Meg that you have bought the tickets and that you have seen the caves.
a2-03-01.target: Hemos comprado los billetes y he visto las cuevas.
a2-03-01.english: We have bought the tickets and I have seen the caves.
a2-03-01.canDo: I can talk about what I have seen and done during a recent outing using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-03-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Have You Seen It Yet?
a2-03-02.scenario: In the boat at Tam Cốc, Daniela asks you whether you have already seen the caves. You have not seen them yet. You also want to know whether she has already bought the tickets.
a2-03-02.prompt: Answer Daniela that you have not seen the caves yet, then ask her whether she has already bought the tickets.
cues: Answer that it has not happened yet
Ask if she has already bought the tickets
a2-03-02.target: No, todavía no. ¿Ya has comprado los billetes?
a2-03-02.english: No, not yet. Have you already bought the tickets?
a2-03-02.canDo: I can ask and answer whether an activity has happened already or not yet.

a2-03-03.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Market
a2-03-03.scenario: At the market near the river, Meg asks how it is going. You have already tried the fruit, but you have not spoken with the sellers yet.
a2-03-03.prompt: Tell Meg that you have already tried the fruit and that you have not spoken with the sellers yet.
cues: Say what you have already tried
Say what you have not done yet
a2-03-03.target: Ya he probado la fruta. Todavía no he hablado con los vendedores.
a2-03-03.english: I have already tried the fruit. I have not spoken with the sellers yet.
a2-03-03.canDo: I can say what I have and have not experienced using ya and todavía no.

a2-03-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Day Out
a2-03-04.scenario: In the afternoon in Tam Cốc, Meg's sister Lauren asks how the day out is going. You have already explored the market, but you have not rested on the terrace yet.
a2-03-04.prompt: Tell Lauren that you have already explored the market and that you have not rested on the terrace yet.
cues: Say what you have already explored
Say what you have not done yet
a2-03-04.target: Ya hemos recorrido el mercado. Todavía no hemos descansado en la terraza.
a2-03-04.english: We have already explored the market. We have not rested on the terrace yet.
a2-03-04.canDo: I can describe a recent day out using the pretérito perfecto with ya and todavía no.

a2-03-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Boat Trip
a2-03-05.scenario: On the way back from the boat trip in Tam Cốc, Daniela asks what you think of the day. You have already seen very beautiful places and this one is your favourite, but you have not tried the typical food yet.
a2-03-05.prompt: Tell Daniela that you have already seen very beautiful places and that you have not tried the typical food yet.
cues: Say what you have already seen
Say what you have not tried yet
a2-03-05.target: Ya hemos visto lugares muy bonitos, pero todavía no he probado la comida típica.
a2-03-05.english: We have already seen very beautiful places, but I have not tried the typical food yet.
a2-03-05.canDo: I can describe a boat trip and discuss what I have already experienced and what I have not done yet.

a2-03-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Outing
a2-03-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the outing in Tam Cốc, Meg asks you about the day. You have already seen the caves, but you have not visited the market yet.
a2-03-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you have already seen and what you have not visited yet.
cues: Say what you have already seen
Say what you have not visited yet
a2-03-consolidation.target: Ya hemos visto las cuevas. Todavía no hemos visitado el mercado.
a2-03-consolidation.english: We have already seen the caves. We have not visited the market yet.
a2-03-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about a recent outing and say what I have and have not experienced.
